Australian PM's Melon Joke Sparks Diplomatic Stir

Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese's joke about a gift of Japanese melons has caused diplomatic friction. During a state dinner, Albanese reportedly joked that the melons, a gift from Japan's Prime Minister Fumio Kishida, were intended to make him "fat". The Japanese ambassador to Australia, Reiichiro Kanazawa, has stated the remark was "misunderstood" and "not a problem". However, Opposition Leader Peter Dutton claimed Albanese "stuffed up" the diplomatic gesture. The incident occurred during a state dinner attended by the Japanese Prime Minister.
